titles.title: La Cucaracha
titles.plot: A writer moves to Mexico and becomes a hit man, but he ends up fighting for his life when he cannot kill a target.

titles.title: Familia
titles.plot: A woman (Macha Grenon) shelters a childhood friend (Sylvie Moreau) with a restless 14-year-old daughter, who are destitute.

titles.title: A Master Builder
titles.plot: A young woman (Lisa Joyce) confronts a gravely ill architect (Wallace Shawn), claiming that he seduced her when she was just an adolescent, but he has no recollection of the encounter.

titles.title: Atlas Shrugged: Part 1
titles.plot: Dagny Taggart (Taylor Schilling), a powerful railroad executive, tries to keep her business afloat while society crumbles around her.

images.caption: Taylor Schilling as Dagny Taggart and Matthew Marsden as James Taggart in "Atlas Shrugged: Part 1."

titles.title: Autumn
titles.plot: Veteran assassin Jean-Pierre (Laurent Lucas) suffers a crisis of conscience during his latest assignment. Abandoning his profession, he raises the ire of mob chieftain Noël (Michel Aumont), who must then send in a novice (Dinara Drukarova) to clean up Jean-Pierre's mess. Jean-Pierre wants a new life with Michelle (Irène Jacob), his childhood sweetheart, but Michelle's theft of a mysterious briefcase may drag him back to the world of crime.

titles.title: Ballad of a White Cow
titles.plot: In a system that leaves no place to doubt, a quest of justice will blur the lines between two connected fate.

titles.title: Black Conflux
titles.plot: The lives of a disillusioned teen and an alienated man converge in the 1980s Newfoundland.

titles.title: Bonds of Grief
titles.plot: Saddened by the loss of a loved one, a woman finds comfort in the kindness of a stranger, and learns that friendships can blossom from the depths of grief.

titles.title: Boris Without Béatrice
titles.plot: A man has an affair to escape the emotional strain caused by caring for his terminally ill wife.

titles.title: Boxing Helena
titles.plot: A rich surgeon (Julian Sands) operates on the object of his obsession, his grotesquely disfigured aloof neighbor (Sherilyn Fenn).

titles.title: A City of Sadness
titles.plot: Soon after Japan relinquishes control of Taiwan in 1945, the Lin brothers face hardships from the changing culture. Bar owner Wen-heung (Chen Sown-yung), the eldest brother, falls foul of local gangsters, Wen-sun disappears, and Wen-leung, scarred by his experiences in the war, ends up in an insane asylum. Deaf-mute photographer Wen-ching (Tony Leung Chiu Wai), the youngest brother, decides to make a stand and fight the Kuomintang government from China that is assuming power.

titles.title: Criminal
titles.plot: A principled doctor faces a deadly dilemma with a dangerous criminal when he barges into her hospital and demands immediate treatment for his brother. With a race against time, every decision can make all the difference.

titles.title: Drunken Birds
titles.plot: Willy's quest to find his long-lost love Marlena has brought him from Mexico to Canada, as a seasonal worker at the Becotte farm. Multiple destinies intersect, moments of magic realism arise, worlds collide, and tensions swell amidst the long days of labor.

titles.title: End of Sentence
titles.plot: After being released from prison, a young man reluctantly embarks on a journey with his estranged father to spread his mother's ashes in her native Ireland.

titles.title: Eternity and a Day
titles.plot: A dying writer (Bruno Ganz), trying to finish the works of a 19th-century poet, rescues a kidnapped child about to be sold.

titles.title: Faith in the Family
titles.plot: A woman who has suffered the devastating loss of her husband and, in the process, the loss of her Christian faith looks to find that belief again.

titles.title: Familiar Touch
titles.plot: Ruth (Kathleen Chalfant), a retired cook, prepares breakfast in her sunny and cozy kitchen -- a dish she seems to have made many times before, although small and puzzling errors now punctuate her comfortable routine. When her son (H. Jon Benjamin) arrives to dine with her, she mistakes him for a suitor. Their "date" takes them to an assisted living facility, which Ruth does not remember that she had previously selected for herself. Among her fellow memory care residents, Ruth feels lost and adrift, certain she has found herself somewhere she does not belong. As she slowly begins to accept the warmth and support of care workers Vanessa (Carolyn Michelle) and Brian (Andy McQueen), she finds new ways to ground herself in her body, even as her mind embarks on a journey all its own. Writer-director Sarah Friedland's coming-of-old-age feature compassionately follows the winding path of octogenarian Ruth's shifting memories and desires while remaining rooted in her sage perspective.

titles.title: Finding Graceland
titles.plot: En route to Memphis, Tenn., on a solemn solo road trip, widower Byron Gruman picks up a disarming hitchhiker who claims to be the late, great Elvis Presley. As Gruman opens up about the loss of his wife, Beatrice, in a tragic car accident, his bizarre passenger becomes a surprisingly powerful source of wisdom and comfort. The duo even picks up a Marilyn Monroe impersonator, Ashley, during the surreal pilgrimage to Graceland.

titles.title: Genealogies of a Crime
titles.plot: An attorney (Catherine Deneuve) defends a young man (Melvil Poupaud) on trial for killing his aunt, a psychiatrist who took him in to study possible homicidal tendencies.

titles.title: Grief Share
titles.plot: Following the journey of a grief share class as they navigate their individual losses, find solace in their shared experiences, and discover the transformative power of faith and compassion. The narrative skillfully weaves together their personal stories, paralleling the parables of Jesus and illuminating the timeless wisdom they hold.

titles.title: Hears My Voice
titles.plot: Hears My Voice tells the story of Victoria Young, a teenage girl whose dreams of becoming a singer are shattered when she wakes up one morning unable to speak above a whisper. For the next four years, she learns to navigate a new life of silence, healing herself and her mom along the way.

titles.title: Heavy
titles.plot: A shy, overweight pizza maker (Pruitt Taylor Vince) likes a teenage waitress (Liv Tyler) at his mother's (Shelley Winters) roadside tavern.

titles.title: Hidden Lies
titles.plot: After his release from prison, Malcolm vows to leave his criminal past behind, but events pull him back into the game, unveiling a trail of secrets.

titles.title: Home
titles.plot: An architect having a midlife crisis visits his old hometown and discovers that everything that was once familiar has now changed.

titles.title: I Used to Be Darker
titles.plot: A runaway (Deragh Campbell) seeks refuge with a relatives (Ned Oldham, Kim Taylor) whose marriage is coming to a bitter end.

titles.title: INSight
titles.plot: Andi, a faithful woman devoted to work, friends and marriage, begins to lose all of it, including her eyesight. Devotedness and denial have her trapped in abuse, but the devastating journey of betrayal and loss may be just the catalyst for Andi to see what she never could before.

titles.title: The Cowboys
titles.plot: A father searches for his missing daughter with his son.

titles.title: Level Cross
titles.plot: A modern girl and an unruly man from different worlds meet at a surreal setup. Despite their differences, they discover unexpected similarities about life.

titles.title: Little Men
titles.plot: Two teens develop a growing friendship in Brooklyn, N.Y., while the feud between their respective parents (Greg Kinnear, Jennifer Ehle) continues to escalate.

titles.title: Loop
titles.plot: Shravanya, a young woman with a bright future, experiences a severe trauma that causes her to lose her memory of two pivotal and devastating events in her life.

titles.title: Lupe Under the Sun
titles.plot: An aging peach picker in California wants to go back to his home in Mexico before he dies.

titles.title: Men Cry Bullets
titles.plot: A nightclub performer (Steven Nelson) falls for a woman novelist (Honey Lauren) who sexually assaults him.

titles.title: Mother of George
titles.plot: Ayodele and Adenike marry and start a new life. As months pass without a pregnancy, Adenike feels torn between her Yoruba culture and her new life in America, struggling to save her marriage.

titles.title: My Sailor, My Love
titles.plot: Howard (James Cosmo), a retired sailor and widower, lives in a house by the sea. His adult daughter Grace (Catherine Walker) hires a caretaker for her father, a lady in her mature years, Annie (Bríd Brennan). Recluse and stubborn, Howard rejects Annie's company, but eventually opens his heart and gives his final love a chance. Grace has her own crisis to unravel and finds her father's romance difficult. Her father's new love reminds her of the affection she missed, as a child and now again as an adult. Annie must face the complex father-daughter relationship, while Howard and Grace must realize their own imperfections.

titles.title: Not on the Lips
titles.plot: In 1925 France, Gilberte (Sabine Azéma) tries to stop her secret ex-husband, Eric (Lambert Wilson), from telling her current husband, Georges (Pierre Arditi), about her past.

titles.title: Nymphomaniac: Volume II
titles.plot: Self-diagnosed nymphomaniac Joe continues with the story of her adulthood, during which her journey of self-discovery leads to darker complications.

titles.title: Or Something
titles.plot: Strangers Olivia and Amir both arrive coincidentally at their friend Teddy's to collect money he owes them. Each desperate for cash, they follow Teddy's orders to visit an elusive Harlem figure, Uptown Mike, to get the cash. Waiting for Mike to arrive home, Olivia and Amir are stuck on a journey together through NYC: on the subway, eating lunch, walking through Central Park, all while bonding over disagreements about sex, dating, religion, and death. They finally reveal why they both need money, though one of them is not completely truthful.

titles.title: Our Time
titles.plot: A husband's uncontrollable jealousy begins to destroy a couple's relationship.

titles.title: Patna Shuklla
titles.plot: When a helpless student has nowhere to turn to except a housewife who is also a small-time lawyer, what they uncover is a quagmire of an educational scam.

titles.title: The Power of Kangwon Province
titles.plot: Recently separated lovers (Baek Jong-hak, Oh Yun-hong) have a series of close encounters at a popular mountain retreat.

titles.title: Raise the Red Lantern
titles.plot: Teenage Songlian (Gong Li), whose family has been devastated by the recent death of her father, becomes the third concubine of wealthy Master Chen (Ma Jingwu). She soon discovers that behind the palatial luxury of life in the master's house, she and her fellow concubines, Zhuoyan (Cao Cuifeng) and Meishan (He Caifei), are pitted against each other in a struggle for his affections. The situation inevitably leads to deception, jealous rages and the revelation of each other's darkest secrets.

titles.title: Samaritan Girl
titles.plot: A policeman (Lee Eol) confronts his teenage daughter (Gwak Ji-min) after learning she is moonlighting as a prostitute.

titles.title: Selah and the Spades
titles.plot: Five factions run the underground life of a prestigious east coast boarding school. The head of The Spades walks a fine line between being feared and being loved.

titles.title: Taboo: Secrets of the Family
titles.plot: Lucas' infidelities have fractured his family. Son Tyler's visit sparks a taboo connection with stepmother Amanda, risking exposure by daughter Jillie. Pressure from Sandra to leave his wife mounts as Amanda's hidden past threatens stability.

titles.title: Take My Eyes
titles.plot: One winter night, a woman named Pilar (Laia Marull) can no longer tolerate her abusive husband, Antonio (Luis Tosar), and she leaves home, taking only a few possessions and her son, Juan (Nicolás Fernández Luna). Seeking solace, Pilar moves into her sister's apartment. However, Juan longs to return to life with his father. But, despite Antonio's promises to seek therapy, Pilar is unsure if her husband is reformed and how to best keep her family together.

titles.title: Thank You for Banking with Us!
titles.original_title: Thank You for Banking with Us!
titles.plot: When their father passes away leaving a large sum of money in the bank, two sisters put their differences aside and join forces against Sharia law, according to which their brother has the right to take double what they are entitled to.

titles.title: The Antique
titles.plot: A young Georgian man named Lado is involved in smuggling antique furniture from Georgia to Russia. Tired of his immaturity, Medea, Lado’s girlfriend, buys for herself the apartment in St. Peterburg’s historic center. It is sold at a very low price because the apartment comes with its owner, Vadim Vadimich - an opinionated, old-fashioned character. At the time of the unlawful deportation of thousands of Georgians from Russia, Lado is caught and deported. The antique warehouse is raided, while Medea hides in a wardrobe.

titles.title: The Delta
titles.plot: A genteel Jew (Shayne Gray) and an immigrant Vietnamese (Thang Chan) living in a Southern town try to cope with their homosexuality.

titles.title: The Door
titles.plot: Emerence, an elderly and private woman, is hired to be the housekeeper of a struggling writer. An event in the writer's life prompts Emerence to disclose details of her traumatizing past, which will bond the two women forever.

titles.title: The Lost Holliday
titles.plot: When Cassandra Marshall (Vivica A. Fox), arrives in Los Angeles to plan the funeral for her estranged son, Damien Holliday (Jabari Redd), she finds the arrangements are already being handled... by her son's husband, Jason Holliday (Jussie Smollett) -- a man and a marriage she knew nothing about. Through Damien's relationship with Jason and their adopted daughter. Arielle, along with the help of Jason's sister, Cheyenne (Brittany Hall) and best friend, Duck (Marquise Vilson) -- Cassandra learns more about her son in death than she ever knew during his life.

titles.title: Toxic
titles.plot: Dreaming of an escape from the bleakness of their hometown, two teens form a unique bond at a local modeling school, where the promise of a better life pushes girls to violate their bodies in increasingly extreme ways.

titles.title: Ucha Dar Babe Nanak Da
titles.plot: As a couple navigates their path, they must learn to surrender to the people they love, even amidst conflict.

titles.title: Untold Scandal
titles.plot: In 18th-century Korea, the bored Madam Jo (Lee Mi-sook) knows her husband has eyes for 16-year-old virgin So-ok (Lee So-yeon), so Jo sends her cousin, Jo-won (Bae Yong-joon), to seduce the young girl before her spouse can. But that's just the beginning of the sexual gamesmanship, as Jo-won instead wants to pursue the repressed and religious Lady Suk (Jeon Do-yeon) ; however, this lustful act might bring about more devastating consequences than the typical bedroom conquest.

titles.title: Veerayi Makkal
titles.plot: A once-close family of three brothers and a sister face growing divides and tensions, but ultimately reunites through forgiveness after a tragedy strikes--reaffirming the strength of familial bonds.

titles.title: Viraaji
titles.plot: The story happens in Visakhapatnam. A group of four people (a film producer, a stand up comedian, a doctor and a pre wedding shoot photographer) goes to a place top attend performa sanmanam event of a celebrity astrologer.

titles.title: Walk Away Renee
titles.plot: Filmmaker Jonathan Caouette uses musical montages and psychedelic sequences to document a road trip through the past and present with his mentally ill mother.

titles.title: West Michigan
titles.plot: Hannah is a seventeen-year-old girl who struggles to find her place in the world. Around the time that she gives up all hope of fitting in, her grandfather falls ill. She and her brother, Charlie, drive up the coast of West Michigan in order to visit him on his deathbed. However, their journey north takes a turn after their car breaks down in rural Michigan, and Hannah's search for meaning grows more crucial than ever.

titles.title: White Girl
titles.plot: A hard-partying, New York college freshman (Morgan Saylor) tries to get a drug dealer (Brian "Sene" Marc) out of jail.

images.caption: Morgan Saylor as Leah in "White Girl."

titles.title: Who's Driving Doug
titles.plot: To escape from his overbearing mother (Daphne Zuniga), a sheltered student (RJ Mitte) embarks on a spontaneous road trip with his college crush (Paloma Kwiatkowski) and his driver (Ray William Johnson).

titles.title: Woman in Gold
titles.plot: Sixty years after fleeing Vienna, Maria Altmann, an elderly Jewish woman, attempts to reclaim family possessions that were seized by the Nazis. Among them is a famous portrait of Maria's beloved Aunt Adele: Gustave Klimt's "Portrait of Adele Bloch-Bauer I." With the help of young lawyer Randy Schoenberg, Maria embarks upon a lengthy legal battle to recover this painting and several others, but it will not be easy, for Austria considers them national treasures.
